_note: The theme beat: someone says, in passing, what the story is about, and the protagonist doesn't listen yet. (Save the Cat's Theme Stated.) Frames, as everywhere: see act_turn's note.
entries: {CLOSE:human} told {first} that {VALUE} mattered more than {PRIZE:!inner}, and {first} did not listen.
In {place}, everyone said {VALUE} {was} worth more than {PRIZE:!inner}, and {first} wondered if it was true.
{SOMEONE:human} warned {first} that {VICE} would cost {VALUE}, and {first} shrugged.
{first} had never asked what {VALUE} cost, only what {PRIZE:!inner} {was} worth.
At {landmark}, {CLOSE:human} spoke of {VALUE}, and {first} thought only of {PRIZE:!inner}.
{place} had a saying about {VALUE}, and {first} {ACT_THING:mundane} {THING} {MANNER} without hearing it.
Nobody in {place} spoke of {TOPIC}, only of {VALUE} and {PRIZE:!inner}.
{CLOSE:human} said {VICE} would take {VALUE} from {first}, and {first} laughed.
{SOMEONE:human} asked {first} what {VALUE} {was} for, and {first} had no answer.
